_note: Source providers the importer knows. Rate limits are per process; the tools fetch single named books and never crawl.

providers.name: Wikisource
providers.access: MediaWiki API, action=parse with a pinned oldid per page
providers.licenceNotes: Public-domain texts stay public domain. Contributor-created content (user translations, annotations) is CC BY-SA and is NOT imported. Header/navigation templates are stripped.
providers.rateLimit: 1 request at a time, retries with back-off, identifying User-Agent

providers.name: Project Gutenberg
providers.access: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/<number>.epub.noimages (single books only; bulk crawling is forbidden by the site)
providers.licenceNotes: Texts are public domain in the USA; this project additionally requires the worldwide-conservative test. The Project Gutenberg licence header/footer and trademark are removed from the distributed text, which the licence permits when the trademark is not used; the provenance record keeps the attribution.
providers.rateLimit: 1 request at a time, retries with back-off, identifying User-Agent

providers.name: Europeana
providers.access: discovery and metadata only; not an import source yet
providers.licenceNotes: Rights vary per item; only items whose rights statement is public domain may be considered, and each needs its own import path.
